_comment: Deny-list for buffer-post-prep. POLICY (2026-06-19): we fan out to EVERY channel — one more channel is ~zero marginal cost, and showing up everywhere widens the surface area for AI search / LLMs to find + cite the content, so low HUMAN engagement is NOT a reason to skip. Proof: Instagram was written off 5/31 as 'over-saturated, low ROI' then by 6/19 drove +30 beehiiv subs (71% IG-attributed). So this list is EMPTY and stays empty for engagement reasons. ONLY add a channel here if it is genuinely BROKEN — auth dead / every post errors — and even then prefer fixing the channel over deny-listing it; NEVER deny-list for low engagement. See memory feedback_promote_channel_priority_data_driven. Mechanism (unchanged): a row matches by channel_id OR service+handle; on match buffer-post-prep prints {"skipped":true,...} and exits 75. EMPTY = nothing skipped. dead-channels.local.json (gitignored) shadows this file if present.
